releaseNote.summary: x-storage: streamed uploads, verified reads (aws-chunked recovery), script stream types and write-back, binding task responses, raw binary function bodies; stores stay Dapr bindings.

fileStreamedUploads.description: x-storage.transport: inline (default, base64 content in the JSON body) | stream | any. For stream/any fields, POST /api/v1/{domain}/workflows/{flow}/files?path=&name=[&version=] reads the raw body (Content-Type = media type, Content-Length required; no JSON, no base64) into one buffer of Content-Length bytes and stores it through the field's Dapr binding (one binding message) and answers 201 with a ticket {file, component, path, name, mimeType, size, eTag, expiresAt}; size and eTag come from the bytes received. The upload is staged in the distributed cache (vnext:{domain}:file-upload:{file}) for FileStorage:Upload:TicketTtlMinutes (default 60); a start or transition claims it once by sending { file } at the same path (same flow and component; the ticket is taken atomically, so two concurrent claims cannot both succeed, and a request that fails afterwards puts it back), the swap stamps the instance as owner and keeps the node's other members. A stream-only field refuses inline content from a client (400 Instance:100048). Limit FileStorage:Upload:MaxBytes (default 64 MiB = the sidecar's --max-body-size, 413 above it). The route skips raw-body capture (RawRequestBodyBufferingMiddleware).

fileReadIntegrity.description: Every x-storage read (functions/file, internal/file, GetFileAsync) checks the stored bytes against the handle's size and sha256 eTag. A complete aws-chunked frame whose payload matches is decoded and served (warning 20512), which recovers objects Dapr 1.17+ bindings.aws.s3 stored framed; anything else is 503 Instance:100047 (error 20513) instead of a silently corrupt body. functions/file and internal/file now answer through FileStreamResult over the verified binding get. The Dapr client no longer caps a received message at gRPC's 4 MB default, so a file above 4 MB reads back (it was 503 ResourceExhausted).

scriptFileStreams.description: The script sandbox allows the in-memory System.IO stream types (Stream, MemoryStream, BufferedStream, Binary/Stream/String readers and writers, TextReader/TextWriter, SeekOrigin, IOException family) and the System.IO.Compression streams (GZip, Deflate, Brotli, ZLib, ZipArchive; the assembly must be granted). File, FileStream, Directory, Path and the rest of System.IO stay banned. New member-level bans in any namespace: StreamReader/StreamWriter path constructors, non-generic Activator, static Type.GetType(string), Type.GetMethod(s)/GetConstructor(s)/GetMember(s)/GetField(s)/GetEvent(s)/FindMembers/GetDefaultMembers/TypeInitializer/InvokeMember, Environment.Exit/FailFast/SetEnvironmentVariable. ScriptFile.OpenRead() wraps a read file in a read-only stream; ScriptBase.PutFileAsync(domain, flow, instance, component, bytes|stream, name, mimeType) stores a processed file and returns its handle; ScriptBase.FileObjectKey(file) names the object key for a DaprBinding task.

daprBindingTaskResponse.description: A DaprBinding task returns the binding's answer to its output mapping: Data is the body as JSON when it parses, else text, else base64 (Metadata.DataEncoding = json|text|base64|none), Headers is the response metadata, and a failure carries the sidecar's gRPC status detail. An unmapped binding task still adds no instance data. Mappings can set the per-call shape: DaprBindingTask.SetOperation / SetData / SetMetadata (e.g. the object key from ScriptBase.FileObjectKey). The call runs through DaprBindingInvocation (shared by both hosts); Workflow:TaskInvocation:Modes:daprbinding = Local runs it from the orchestration sidecar, where x-storage components live (default stays Remote).

rawFunctionBinaryBody.description: A rawResponse function whose output Data is a byte[] or a ScriptFile answers the bytes (Content-Length, the author's Content-Type, else the file's mimeType, else application/octet-stream) instead of a quoted base64 JSON string (vnext-client-sdk-core#99). FunctionResponseOutput.IsBinary keeps a function response cache hit binary.

migrations.title: The x-storage swap keeps the client's other members of the file node
migrations.description: Before: the swap cleared the file node, so members a client put beside the file (a FilePicker row's documentType) were dropped before the mapping ran (vnext-client-sdk-core#137). Now only content is removed and the seven handle members are written; other members stay. A master schema with additionalProperties: false on the file node must declare those members.

migrations.title: Stored bytes that do not match the handle are refused instead of served
migrations.description: Before: whatever the store returned was served (an aws-chunked framed object 44+ bytes longer than the file, with an ETag naming the original). Now the bytes must match the handle's size and sha256; a framed object whose payload matches is recovered, anything else answers 503 Instance:100047 and logs 20513.

migrations.title: Reflection-by-name, non-generic Activator and process termination no longer compile in scripts
migrations.description: Activator (non-generic members), static Type.GetType(string), Type.GetMethod(s)/GetConstructor(s)/GetMember(s)/GetField(s)/GetEvent(s)/FindMembers/GetDefaultMembers/TypeInitializer/InvokeMember and Environment.Exit/FailFast/SetEnvironmentVariable are rejected at compile ("banned member"). None of them was found in any shipped domain package (source and base64-embedded code, 2026-10-31). The System.IO stream types became usable at the same time.

migrations.title: A byte[] raw body is written as bytes
migrations.description: Before: a byte[] output was serialized as a quoted base64 JSON string with Content-Type application/json. Now the bytes are written as is (application/octet-stream unless the output sets a Content-Type). A client that decoded the base64 string must read the body as bytes.

migrations.title: The output mapping of a DaprBinding task sees the binding's answer
migrations.description: Before: the task response carried no data (only BindingName/Operation metadata). Now Data, Headers and Metadata.DataEncoding carry the binding's answer. An unmapped task still adds no instance data.

knownIssues.description: Dapr 1.17+ bindings.aws.s3 builds its transfer manager without options, so every https upload carries a CRC32 trailer as Content-Encoding: aws-chunked; a store that does not decode it keeps the frame as the object (vnext-client-sdk-core#145; any runtime version on a daprd 1.17+ sidecar). AWS_REQUEST_CHECKSUM_CALCULATION on the sidecar does not change it and no component metadata does. The runtime recovers such objects on read; a consumer reading the bucket directly sees the frame. Use a store that decodes aws-chunked, an http endpoint in a trusted network, or pin the sidecar to daprd 1.16.x until components-contrib exposes the option.

A streamed upload that no start or transition claims before its ticket expires leaves its object in the store (the staging entry expires, the object does not). Use the store's lifecycle rules, as for other x-storage orphans.

Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable, Type.GetProperty, Type.Assembly, AppDomain and AssemblyLoadContext remain allowed because shipped packages use them (vnext-sys-flow, morph-idm); combined with dynamic they still reach reflection. The analyzer guards against accidental and low-effort misuse; isolation is the host's (read-only file system, no secrets on disk, egress policy, curated plugin directory).

Aether's HttpBodyLoggingMiddleware copies every response not in Telemetry:Logging:ExcludedPaths into memory before sending it, even with body logging off, so a functions/file or internal/file download is held in memory once once more after the binding get. Excluding the two routes removes the copy but also their HTTP server spans, because Aether's tracing filter uses Logging.ExcludedPaths as well. Shipped configuration keeps the spans; the fix belongs in Aether.
